name: Jeero
author: Jeroen Schmit

sections.description:
Jeero automatically imports events from your ticketing system into WordPress. Keep showtimes, prices, descriptions, images and ticket links up to date.

Supported ticketing solutions include ActiveTickets, AudienceView Professional, Billeto, Billetweb, BravoBase, Brown Paper Tickets, Chaplin, Ciné Office, Ents24, Eventive, Fienta, KinoTickets Online, Ovatic, OvationTix, PatronBase, Place2Book, Reservix, RTS, Sirius, Stager, ThunderTix, TicketingCiné, Ticketlab, Ticketmaster, Ticketmatic, Ticketportal, TicketSolve, TicketSource, TicketWeb, Tixly and Veezi.

Supported calendars include All In One Event Calendar, Goodlayers themes that use the Event Post Type plugin, EventON, Events Schedule WordPress Plugin, Modern Events Calendar, Sugar Calendar, Theater for WordPress, The Events Calendar, Very Simple Event List, WP Event Manager and custom post types.

Jeero MCP lets AI assistants access your imported events and manage your imports through the official WordPress MCP Adapter. See the setup instructions.

Are you missing a ticketing solution?

Contact me to request support for your ticketing system or calendar plugin.

Get started for free

Import up to ten upcoming events for free. Upgrade to a paid plan when you need more.
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins -> Add New and look for ‘Jeero’.
  2. Install and activate the Jeero plugin.
  3. Go to Jeero in the WordPress admin and click on ‘Add Import’.
  4. Select your ticketing solution and your calendar plugin and submit the form.
  5. Fill in the missing fields in the form. Submit the form.

Wait a couple of minutes (max 5) and go to your Calendar plugin.

You should see the first 10 upcoming events that are coming from your ticketing solutions.
sections.faq:
How do I connect an AI client with Jeero MCP?

With your Jeero import already working, install and activate the official MCP Adapter by WordPress.org via Plugins → Add New.

In WordPress, go to Jeero → Settings → MCP server, enable Jeero MCP and click Save Changes. Then click Copy URL next to the Jeero MCP endpoint and paste it into your AI client’s MCP server URL field.

Follow the Jeero MCP setup instructions to connect your AI client. The endpoint is generated for your WordPress installation, including installations in a subdirectory and sites using plain permalinks. If the adapter is inactive or missing, Settings shows installation instructions instead of an endpoint.

How do I upgrade?

Go to the Jeero menu in the WordPress admin and click on the upgrade link next the import that needs to import more than 10 upcoming events.

How much does it cost?

Subscription rates range from €30 – €70 per month, depending on your total number of upcoming events.
